note: Both sets contain the same nine claims and share the same misbindings: A1/A4 are swapped (A1 is FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6, A4 is FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 2) and B1/B4 are swapped (B1 is FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5, B4 is FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3), and both treat 'T.O. STEEL' as a condition on the E6 roof beam when it is part of the detail title. The only substantive difference is the edge-radius claim, where B keeps the full condition 'around edges of openings in beams' while A truncates it to 'around edges'. Because B preserves the needed condition more faithfully and is otherwise identical, B is marginally better.
